The Switch is a structure in Warcraft Rumble. It appears in a myriad of maps and missions, sometimes multiple per map and lane. When tapped, as the description states, it will swap the direction of the lane. Minions that walk near or over the switch will proceed to follow whatever direction the arrow is pointing, allowing the player to control the path their units take.

.]] Swirlies refer to the ground-based, circular, or swirled animations that indicate an area of effect attack from bosses, mobs, or spells. They force the players to move around the area rather than staying in one spot. However, for the longest period of World of Warcraft, they have been historically hard to see in many instances, especially when the color of the swirl is similar to the ground itself and the full length of the swirl isn't exactly clear on where it ends. They can also disappear or clip into uneven, sloped terrain. In patch 11.0.0, a bit more clear circle was added to some swirly animations. With patch 11.1.0, the graphics were further improved by making the colors "pop" more

T'era was a naaru who once encountered the Nethersent of Nashabor, a group of draenei and other refugees seeking shelter from the Burning Legion. She offered to take them somewhere safer, but the Nethersent were divided over whether to accept her aid. Some found comfort in her presence, while others remained skeptical of her intentions. Before a decision could be reached, T'era and the Nethersent were abducted by the Domanaar and brought to the Voidstorm. After being separated from the refugees, T'era was captured by the Shadowguard, who sought to corrupt her into a servant of Xal'atath by forcing her to fall to the Void. Talandra Dawnsprite is a blood elf questgiver located at Windrunner Village in Eversong Woods. She initially presents herself as an apothecary running a shop alongside her friend Amalthea Dawnsprite. It is later revealed that she is a necromancer using the dark arts to help ease her friend's torment, once a heroic Farstrider who had been killed and raised into a banshee by the Scourge.

Players have a choice of choosing one reward each week and can claim the rewards by connecting their Coca-Cola account with the Battle.net account.
